frame.Description: Index of the frame in the run's released clip of this view (videos/), from 0; frame 0 is the movement start. Where the source video began after the movement start, the clip starts with black frames (manifest <view>_lead_black_frames) and the first row is the first frame with an image; frames without an image have no row. A row describes the image of its frame: where a clip's first image repeats the next one (a seek artefact of the clip cut), the two rows are equal. Keypoints exist for the clips of the test participants (splits.json) with vicon_valid and <view>_valid.

time.Description: Capture time of the frame: run time, seconds since the movement start, through the video-game clock alignment (manifest <view>_align_err).

left_shoulder_x.Description: Horizontal position of the left shoulder VICON proxy (LSHO) as estimated by RTMW-X + ViTMS temporal head, as output (not cut at a score threshold), image px of the full frame, origin at the top-left corner, x to the right, y down; n/a where the model gives none.

left_shoulder_y.Description: Vertical position of the left shoulder VICON proxy (LSHO) as estimated by RTMW-X + ViTMS temporal head, as output (not cut at a score threshold), image px of the full frame, origin at the top-left corner, x to the right, y down; n/a where the model gives none.

left_shoulder_score.Description: n/a: the temporal head gives no confidence (the benchmark uses every position).
